exposure: Novel IUD insertion technique at caesarean delivery (using insertion straw to direct threads through cervix)
Method for lengthening one IUD thread using part of the other thread
outcome: Avoidance of thread inclusion in uterotomy closure
Ensured visibility of threads at follow-up
Avoidance of risks associated with braided suture extensions
finding: This paper describes a novel technique for intrauterine device (IUD) placement during caesarean delivery that aims to protect IUD threads, ensure their alignment through the cervix, and avoid complications like thread inclusion or nonvisibility, alongside a simple method for thread lengthening.
mod_finding: The described novel IUD insertion technique is specifically designed for placement during caesarean delivery, addressing risks associated with IUD threads during this mode of birth.
